svg.title: Tenant architecture: the sign-in and data path
svg.desc: Architecture diagram with 11 components and 10 connections in 3 boundaries. Data center: Reverse proxy, Application network. Application network (in Data center): Web / BFF, Sign-in, Domain API, Data zone. Data zone (in Application network): Domain data, Audit log. Main path: Teacher, parent → Browser → Reverse proxy → Web / BFF → Domain API → Domain data. Most connected: Domain API (5 connections). Nothing leads into Teacher, parent and School records. Teacher, parent (person): connects to Browser (uses). Browser (frontend): connects to Reverse proxy (calls, via HTTPS). School records (external system): connects to Domain API (master data, via REST/JSON). Reverse proxy (security): connects to Web / BFF (forwards). Web / BFF (service): connects to Sign-in (signs in, via OIDC) and Domain API (queries, via user context). Sign-in (security): no outgoing connection. Domain API (service): connects to Domain data (reads, writes, via SQL/TLS), Audit log (logs) and SIEM / SOC (events, via Syslog). Domain data (database): connects to Backup (backs up). Audit log (database): no outgoing connection. Backup (storage): no outgoing connection. SIEM / SOC (external system): no outgoing connection. Emphasized: Sign-in. Emphasized path: Web / BFF → Domain API → Domain data. Legend: person, frontend, service, database, storage, security, external system, emphasized, solid line, dashed line, emphasized path.
svg.text: Tenant architecture: the sign-in and data path

polyline.title: Web / BFF → Domain API: queries [user context]
Domain API → Domain data: reads, writes [SQL/TLS]
